newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - sterling, dollar, lire switches.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - sterling, dollar, lire switches.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on sterling, dollars, lire and yen on Wednesday.
Sanwa International suggests buying the Abbey National 7.75 pct bond, due December 2003 and selling the Abbey National 7.125 pct bond due March 2001.

British Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown, said on Tuesday that measures announced in the House of Commons should lead to a fall in long-term interest rates. This should contribute to a flatter yield curve, given the impetus for short-term rates is still to head higher, Sanwa said.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY This switch offers a yield pick-up of 19 basis points, this is 10 b.p. more than the pick-up offered by two gilts with similar maturities.
BUY Export-Import Bank of Japan 6.50 pct 10/05
STRATEGY This trade is ratings neutral, offers a yield pick-up around 39 bp and a half point cash takeout.
STRATEGY The move into Rabobank and out of SBC offers a 30 b.p. yield-pick plus a credit pick-up, whilst the switch out of Roche into Rabobank offers a yield pick-up of 40 b.p.
STRATEGY DSL is cheaper through the swap and offers an attractive pick-up in yield of about 46 b.p. plus a pick-up in liquidity.
STRATEGY Credit Local is expensive against the swap and the BTP, at 32 b.p. and 13 b.p through respectively.
The DSL bond offers a 16 b.p. pick-up in yield for only a small increase in duration and trades around 22 b.p. through the swap.

STRATEGY The EIB bond on the sell side has in the last month outperformed the EIB bond on the buy side by approximately 95 b.p. in price terms. The bond on the sell side is expensive against the swap and the BTP compared to the buy side and the switch offers a 16 b.p. pick-up in yield.
STRATEGY This switch gives a pick-up of 4 b.p. --Chris Young, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7970
